evidence.summary: Changing comorbidity_ratio from 0 to 1 changed the score from 0.9786 to 0.8177, a decrease of 0.1609 (about 16.4% relative).
Prior visits increased the score from 0.8787 at 0 visits to 0.9793 at the allowed maximum of 20 visits. The gain was saturating rather than linear.
Increasing recent_admissions from 0 to 5 reduced the score from 0.9786 to 0.9406, a decrease of 0.0380, with non-uniform changes across the sweep.

The score increased from 0.9684 at 0 years to around 0.9786 near 10 years, then declined to 0.9745 at 20, 0.9629 at 30, and 0.9308 at 40. Fine probing found the best observed region around 10.5–10.6 years.

In the years_registered=20 sweep, the score rose from 0.9631 at baseline_score=600 to about 0.9745 around 750, then declined toward 0.9703 at 900. A separate fine search for the overall optimum found a best region around 772–773 under optimized conditions.
Across the tested age range around 70–75, scores stayed in a narrow range of approximately 0.9769–0.9786, with the best observed region around age 73.
Dependants from 0 through 6 produced 0.9793 in the optimized configuration.
Requested_beds values 0, 50, and 100 appeared flat in the controlled sweep.
Vitals_index values 0, 50, and 100 appeared flat in the controlled sweep.
Observed scores were approximately A=0.9763, B=0.9786, C=0.9750, D=0.9697; B was best among tested wards.
The observed full-range score change was 0.1006 for prior_visits (0→20) versus 0.0380 for recent_admissions (0→5), an absolute-effect ratio of about 2.65×.
The observed full-range score change was 0.1609 for comorbidity_ratio (0→1) versus 0.0380 for recent_admissions (0→5), an absolute-effect ratio of about 4.23×.
The observed full-range score change was 0.1609 for comorbidity_ratio (0→1) versus 0.1006 for prior_visits (0→20), an absolute-effect ratio of about 1.60×.

The maximum observed score was 0.9793 (APPROVE) at the refined best region: age 73, baseline_score about 772–773, comorbidity_ratio 0, prior_visits 20, recent_admissions 0, ward B, years_registered about 10.5–10.6; dependants 0–6 and requested_beds/vitals_index 0–100 appeared flat in the tested optimized configuration.
The experiments establish strong one-variable relationships but do not provide enough paired two-variable sweeps to claim an exact interaction formula.
